_comment: AUDIT FIX: the real file at src/main/resources/firebase-service-account.json contained a genuine, live Firebase Admin SDK private key. That file has been removed from this delivery. This example file shows the shape FirebaseConfig.java expects, with every value replaced by a placeholder. DO NOT put a real key back at src/main/resources/firebase-service-account.json — FirebaseConfig already degrades gracefully (push notifications simply stay disabled with a log warning) when no file is present at FIREBASE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_PATH, which is the intended state until you wire up a NEW, rotated key from outside the repo (see docker-compose.yml for the volume-mount pattern already set up for this).
